description: Image Description: The image features a uniquely carved wooden chair designed in the shape of a bear. The backrest of the chair is sculpted to resemble the upper body of a bear standing upright, with detailed carvings that mimic fur texture and facial features, including ears, eyes, a nose, and an open mouth showing teeth. The arms of the chair extend from the bear's forearms, curving outward and downward to form armrests. The seat is a flat, rectangular wooden plank
